title: Rendering of white pill-shaped object over mountain range and town
description: Color composite image showing a smooth white, elongated pill- or capsule-shaped object superimposed in a clear blue sky above a rugged mountain range. In the foreground are a grassy slope, a road guardrail and a residential area at the mountain's base. The object appears digitally added to a landscape photograph to illustrate a reported sighting; no caption is present.
